{"metadata":{"description":"StudyHub: a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns your own material into questions and spaced review · 把自己的资料变成题目与间隔复习的 DSH 学习插件","id":"gh:1367673687","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-web-studyhub","slug":"EricWang1358/dsh-web-studyhub","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","education","flashcards","spaced-repetition","study"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"StudyHub: a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns your own material into questions and spaced rev"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"iew · 把自己的资料变成题目与间隔复习的 DSH 学习插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# StudyHub"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Turn your lecture slides into questions that each link back to their page; finish a round and see yo"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"slides into questions that each link back to their page; finish a round and see yourself getting it."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Free and open source, your materials stay on your computer; pick your own model and pay for what you"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"and open source, your materials stay on your computer; pick your own model and pay for what you use."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"StudyHub is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), an AI agent app. DSH runs as a desktop app or as a "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"web page served from your own computer, and StudyHub opens inside it."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Try the demo · Install guide · Release 4.6.1 · Changelog"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The demo runs in your browser with sample questions and prepared AI replies. It needs no install and"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" no key, and your progress there stays in that browser."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## At a glance"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Made for:** students who learn from slides, PDFs, notes and recorded lectures, in English or Chi"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"nese.
- **Cost:** StudyHub is free and open source (MIT). Browsing sources, answering questions and "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"review scheduling are free, with no model calls. Generating questions and AI help are billed by your"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" model provider. StudyHub shows the estimated tokens before a generation run and the actual tokens a"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"fter it, and **Statistics** totals the last 7 or 30 days.
- **Network and cost:** supported regions,"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" free allowances and pricing depend on each provider’s current terms. If installing from the GitHub "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"address fails, see the notes under Quick start.
- **Computers:** the install links below cover Windo"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ws x64 and macOS on Apple silicon. For other systems, check current DSH support or use the web versi"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"on with Node.js 22.19 or later.
- **Requires:** DSH 0.2 (0.2.0-rc.2 or later, below 0.3).
- **Your d"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"ata:** the library is a folder on your computer. Data and privacy lists what is sent where."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What you can do"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Make questions from your own sources.** Pick pages or chapters and generate flashcards, single- "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"or multiple-choice, open-response or fill-in-the-blank questions. Every question cites its passage, "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"and you review the draft before you publish it.
- **Move between questions and sources.** A citation"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" opens the passage it came from. In a source, paragraph and table markers lead to the questions and "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"explanations linked to them.
- **Practise and review.** Start today's study from the **Study library"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"**, shape each course's **Learning method** (`学法`) or ask the main chat for **AI-guided study** (`AI"},{"id":"p12s7","text":" 带学`), click **Help me understand** on any question, and let FSRS-6 schedule your reviews.
- **Add e"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"xam focus highlights, even from screenshots.** Drop chat screenshots, whiteboard photos or scope not"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"es into **Add exam focus…** (works with both vision and text-only models such as DeepSeek): focus to"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"pics schedule at shorter intervals, go first in daily rounds and study plans, and generate deeper ap"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"plication and advanced questions. Once topics are saved, the home shows how many are mastered, not y"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"et and without questions, with a link to practise the ones you can't do yet; **Course settings** lis"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"ts each topic with its questions.
- **Find weak points.** Use **Mistakes & weak points**, **Statisti"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"cs** and **Mock exam**, which offers a multiple-choice paper, a case paper or an oral interview.
- *"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"*Finish with a daily recap.** After answering 10 distinct questions in one course on the same day, g"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"enerate one recap across its chapters. Retries count once. Choose a friendly or professional tone an"},{"id":"p12s17","text":"d opt into automatic generation in Settings. Recaps use the source reader; saving one as a source an"},{"id":"p12s18","text":"d publishing on CSDN are separate actions.
- **Turn recordings into text.** Import a lecture recordi"},{"id":"p12s19","text":"ng, or transcribe a **Live class** as it happens, and get a Chinese–English transcript you can gener"},{"id":"p12s20","text":"ate questions from.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| You want to | You need | Cost |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Take the sample course and tour, browse sources, practise existing questions | StudyHub only | Fre"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e, no model calls |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Use StudyHub"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Data and privacy"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Stays on your computer**"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- The library: sources and their original files, decks, answers and review schedules, saved in shard"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"s. By default it is in the DSH session's workspace folder; choose another folder in **Settings › Lib"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"rary & model**.
- Transcription keys, in `study/` in your DSH home (by default `~/.dsh/study/`). The"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"y never enter the library, exports or backups. DSH keeps the model keys. (A MinerU token saved by a "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"version before 3.5.5 stays in `study/mineru.json`; nothing reads it any more, and you can delete it."},{"id":"p19s6","text":")
- The usage frequency record, if you turn it on in **Settings › Usage frequency record**. It is of"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"f by default, and StudyHub never sends it anywhere (details)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Leaves your computer only when you use the feature**"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Generating questions or asking for help sends the selected source text to your model provider thro"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ugh DSH. **Suggest a focus** sends only titles and headings.
- Recordings go to your transcription p"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rovider. PDF conversion with MinerU runs on this computer; installing it downloads the program and i"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ts models (from mainland mirrors or the official sources) and uploads nothing.
- The update check as"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ks GitHub for the latest version and sends no study data."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Backups and older libraries**"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- In **Settings › Import, schedule and backup**, **Backup & restore** exports one JSON file with you"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"r sources, decks, review progress and answers. Original files that were copied into the library are "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"included; originals attached by reference are only listed.
- A restore first saves the current libra"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ry under `backups/`. It is refused while a generation job is running.
- An older library is migrated"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" on its first write, and its original file is backed up. Libraries missing newer optional fields sta"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"y usable, and data from a plugin that is not installed is kept.
- To import a library from the older"},{"id":"p23s7","text":" `study-lib-spar` tool, use the same Settings category and choose the folder that holds `study-lib.j"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"son`, `nodes/` and `quizzes/` (not the tool's source code). The import only reads those files, keeps"},{"id":"p23s9","text":" the due dates, intervals and sources it can parse, and importing again does not overwrite existing "},{"id":"p23s10","text":"tervals and sources it can parse, and importing again does not overwrite existing progress.
